name: Sci-Fi Valley Con
blurb: A twice-yearly sci-fi and pop-culture convention at the Blair County Convention Center in Altoona, with celebrity guests, cosplay and tabletop gaming.

editions.evidence: Homepage slide text and page title: 'SCI-FI VALLEY CON October 16-18, 2026 BLAIR COUNTY CONVENTION CENTER ALTOONA, PENNSYLVANIA'.

Homepage text: 'MEET OUR SPRING CONVENTION COMING UP NEXT ON JUNE 11-13, 2027 TWO SHOWS A YEAR FOR TWICE THE FUN!'. No separate venue is named for this show, so the convention's regular home (Blair County Convention Center) is assumed; no guests are listed for it yet.

notes: Runs two shows a year (confirmed on-site: 'TWO SHOWS A YEAR FOR TWICE THE FUN!'); the fall show (Oct 16-18, 2026) has a full celebrity lineup heavy with Grimm, Gotham, Halloweentown and Under the Dome cast members, while the next spring show (June 11-13, 2027) has only its dates announced so far. Site footer reads 'Sci-Fi Valley Con 2011-2026 © by Assett Promotions Ltd' (batch note said 'Assett Conventions'; used the official site's own company name). Skipped two guests marked 'Cancelled:' on the celebrity-guests page (Sasha Roiz, Rachelle Lefevre) per the research rules. 'Wildefell Wolves' (wildlife/animal ambassadors) and 'Samurai Jill' (a cosplayer) are also real booked guests on that page, not sponsors, so they were picked too.
